- 6wk_weekbyweek_timeline.xlsx (timeline + owner columns)

2) Any mandatory security evidence we should link in the MAP (e.g., SOC 2 report, approved IP policies)?
3) Preferred dates/times for the kickoff workshop next week (we have openings Wed 6/11 or Thu 6/12).

Thanks — looking forward to your edits.

Mina / Ben / Alicia —

I added a short "Technical Validation" section to the MAP doc (link in attachments) with three checkpoints:

Week 1 (quick smoke): inference correctness on 50 anonymized samples; perf sanity check (p95 latency < 250ms on a 512 token request).
Week 3 (scale test): continuous workload at expected pilot QPS for 1 hour; KV cache effectiveness review; token cost estimate vs baseline.
Week 5 (acceptance): end-to-end scenario run with stakeholder sign-off, quality sampling and SLA check (99% success rate on synthetic acceptance set).

Inline notes for Tom: I've left two technical options for hosting the pilot (hosted API vs. dedicated capacity) with trade-offs. If we need to tighten thresholds, tell me which metric you want stricter.

Attachment stubs included: success_pathway_MAP_v1.gdoc (updated), 6wk_weekbyweek_timeline.xlsx (owners filled), technical_validation_checklist.md (short checklist).

—Marissa
